units.source_text: 向蒙推诚相爱，不胜感荷。

en.t: You have always treated me with sincere affection, and I am deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 但念‘交游过分亲’，不免常多悔恨耳。”

en.t: But when I think that our friendship has become too intimate, I cannot help feeling constant regret.

units.source_text: 屡次回头，良久方才别去。

en.t: He looked back again and again, and only after a long while did he finally take his leave.

units.source_text: 宰相去后，源氏公子更加悲伤，日夜忧愁叹息。

en.t: After the Councillor had gone, Prince Genji grew even more sorrowful, grieving and sighing day and night.
